summary: Operator page + 2026 park map read: 47 lots with water/sewer/20-30-50 A, pull-throughs 40-55 ft (back-ins only 20 ft), showers, laundry, phone reservations, closed for the season (no dates). No rate posted anywhere; price rests on RV Life $$. Not a Good Sam Park (stored false stands). No Google listing of its own. Pin on the park.
flags: Price: the operator posts no rate (page and map silent; 'Reservation: Call 800.453.7827'). Ordinary private park with a working page and phone, so it passes on the stored RV Life $$ tier (avg $21); nothing long-stay about it.
Fit: only the 28 pull-throughs (sites 12-31, 40-47; 40-55 ft, 50 A) fit a 23-ft motorhome; the 19 back-in spots are posted at 20 ft ('Back in sites 20''). Fits, via the pull-throughs.

Google: no separate listing for the RV park; a search lands on the casino itself (Shooting Star Casino, 3.8 from 3,854 reviews, which rates the casino, not the campground). Nothing to apply the 4.0/25 screen to.

Waterfront: stored `not waterfront` kept. On imagery the back-in column on the east side (sites 1-11 on the operator's map, the 20-ft spots) lies some 25-40 m from the Wild Rice River behind a lane and a wooded strip; at most a partial view through trees, and those spots are not ones a 23-ft rig fits anyway. No change proposed.
Phone 800-453-7827 and website confirmed. Pin 47.30608,-95.96361 is in the RV park (Good Sam directory point ~50 m away).
